Underwriting Reference (informational)
📋 Risk Classification Tiers
Standard Lives: Age ≤45, no PED, BMI 18–30, no adverse lifestyle, SI ≤₹50L → Instant acceptance, no medical tests.
Mild–Moderate Risk: Age ≤55, controlled HTN/DM (<5 yr), family history CAD/Cancer, minor surgery, BMI 30–35 → UW discretion, SI restricted to ≤₹10L, medical tests may be called.
High Risk: Age >55, critical illness/remission, cancer remission >5 yr stable, BMI >35, CKD/cardio/neuro/onco follow-up, hazardous occupations → Mandatory RM-Health approval (Annexure A), no PED waiver.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family Definition & Eligibility
Eligible relationships: Self, Legally Wedded Spouse, Dependent Children (day 1 till dependency), Physically Dependent Disabled Child (no age limit), Parents, Parents-in-law, Unmarried Dependent Siblings (brothers <25, dependent sisters incl. divorced/widowed), Grandparents, Grandparents-in-law.

Proposer: Must be ≥18 yrs.

Cessation at renewal: Child attaining financial independence, marriage of girl child / sister, employment of dependent brother/sister → ineligible. A separate policy with continuity benefits per IRDAI portability/migration norms is available.
⏱ Age Loadings (auto-applied)
Up to 65 yrs: Nil loading
66–70 yrs: 10% on base premium for life (reduces to 5% after 3 claim-free years)
71–80 yrs: 25% on base premium for life (reduces to 15% after 3 claim-free years)
Above 80 yrs: 50% on base premium for life (no reduction)
💡 If the member was already insured before age 66 (i.e. entry age ≤ 65), enter their Entry Age below the member — loading will be waived automatically.
🩺 PED Waiting Period Buyback (UW reference only)
Available only at policy inception, on payment of additional premium and subject to UW acceptance. Member-wise. Applies only to base SI (not on later enhancements). Not applicable for Clause 4.2 Permanent Exclusions.

Premium Plan: Standard 3 yrs → 2 yrs or 1 yr
Elite Plan: Standard 2 yrs → 1 yr
Royal Plan (≤45 yrs): Standard 1 yr → 1 yr (no buyback needed)
Royal Plan (>45 yrs): Standard 2 yrs → 1 yr

Additional premium rate not specified in current Premium Chart — confirmed with underwriter at proposal stage.
🎁 No Claim Bonus / Cumulative Bonus
At each renewal, policyholder chooses EITHER Cumulative Bonus (SI enhancement) OR 2% Premium Discount (already toggleable above).

Cumulative Bonus (CB) per claim-free year:
Premium Plan: 10% of opted SI (max 100% of SI)
Elite Plan: 20% of opted SI (max 100% of SI)
Royal Plan ≤₹25L: 25% of opted SI (max 200% of SI)
Royal Plan >₹25L: 50% of opted SI (max 200% of SI)

On claim: CB reduces by same % as accrual rate (cannot go below zero).
Structure: Individual = per insured; Floater = whole-policy; Floater-Floater = per group.
🔁 Portability & Free Look
Portability: Available at renewal only (not mid-term). Entire policy ports, not member-wise. Submit 30–60 days before renewal (15-day grace possible with no break). Existing insurer shares data within 72 hours; acquiring insurer decides within 5 days. No charges. No commission payable on ported case in Year 1.

Free Look Period: 30 days from policy receipt. New policies only (not renewal/port/migration). Refund less stamp duty + medical exam cost (+ proportionate risk premium if risk commenced).
📄 Other Statutory Provisions
Grace Period: 15 days (monthly mode), 30 days (other modes). No cover during unpaid period.
Mid-term Inclusion: Newborn (from DOB), Newly Married Spouse (within 90 days). Pro-rata premium. Waiting periods start from inclusion date.
Mid-term Deletion: Only on death (with certificate).
Enhancement of SI: At renewal only · upgrade only (no downgrade) · no PED buyback on enhanced portion · waiting periods restart for enhanced SI · base SI continuity unaffected.
Proposal Decision Timeline: Within 7 days. Income proof required for SI ≥ ₹25L.
Cash Limit: ₹49,999 max (statutory).
Record Preservation: Minimum 5 years post last renewal.
